race.comment: SINGULAR (4) gets the nod off a brave second in a BM65 at Townsville. His record around this distance is solid and the slight drop gives him a strong platform. NOVELA (1) is knocking on the door of another win and keeps an important claim to aid with the big weight. Expect him to hunt forward again and prove tricky to reel in. DIAMOND LUCY (11) has a persuasive counter-case after doing her best work late at Townsville after settling a mile back, and her Bowen win two runs back reads well with Chris Whiteley back aboard. DARTS DALY (8) resumes for Michael Geaney with a neat Townsville trial behind him, and his established distance profile make him a genuine threat if he is forward enough. RUSSIAN SUMMER (7) had interference at Ewan when beaten just under three lengths and carries less weight now, His recent form isn't as clean as the top pair, but he has enough 1250m substance to press for a result.
